slides.title: Telling stories and anecdotes
slides.subtitle: Narrative tenses and storytelling phrases
goals: Structure a story: set the scene, the problem, the end.
Combine past simple, continuous and perfect.

head: Stage
Useful language
rows: This happened a few years ago… / You won't believe what happened…
It was raining and we were walking home…
Suddenly… / All of a sudden… / Out of nowhere…
In the end… / Luckily… / Since then…

items.en: Last year I was traveling to Monterrey by bus.
I was reading when suddenly the bus stopped.
A tire had exploded, so we waited for two hours.
In the end, I made a new friend on that bus!

slides.title: Listener reactions
pairs: No way! What did you do?
In the end, I got the job.
I'd left my passport at home.

items.a: It was a cold night and we were walking home.
All of a sudden, we heard a strange noise.
Luckily, it was just a cat.
